title: Eurostat hlth_cd_iap: Health impacts of air pollution, Italy (PM2.5, annual)
summary: Eurostat JSON-stat table hlth_cd_iap giving annual national health-impact indicators for PM2.5 in Italy (years of life lost and premature deaths, each as number and as rate). It is annual, national (geo=IT only) and has 72 cells covering 2005 to 2023, with no missing cells in the response. It does not provide hourly pollutant, traffic, weather or clinic data, and has no 2024-2025 values.

quality_notes: Grain is annual, so it cannot meet N1-N3 (hourly pollutant, traffic, weather) or N4-N5 (daily or event clinic data). It is relevant only to N6 (annual national PM2.5 deaths context, could priority).
Coverage does not reach the production window: data ends 2023, while production requires 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. No 2024 or 2025 values are in the response.
Prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 overlaps only 2005 in this table, and the 2005 value is a single annual figure.

The time dimension skips 2006 (values 2005, 2007 ... 2023). Expected cells are 72 and value count is 72, so the gap is in the time series itself, not a missing-cell flag. Analysts should not interpolate silently.
No separate documentation for the rate base (per what population) or for the YLL/PMD methodology was retrieved; the table only carries unit codes NR and RT.

The candidate record's why_relevant calls it an accepted Step 2b source. No licence or agreement evidence for Eurostat was found in the register, so that acceptance is not confirmed by the sources read here.
Metadata shows an update on 2025-12-09 but no refresh cadence is stated.
